name: Creature Comforts

text.trigger: A player has a survivor at the colony.
text.vignette: A long cold week has worn the colony to a thread, and someone suggests burning fuel for hot water and one proper warm evening. Three cans would hardly be missed, they say, which is exactly what everyone always says about fuel.

options.burn-the-fuel: The players together put 3 Fuel cards on the waste pile (the active player's first, then clockwise) and morale rises by 1. Only possible if the hands hold 3 Fuel cards between them.

notes: src: Crossroad_cards_v1.1.xlsx.txt card #21; The single printed option is "may place 3 fuel...; if not, nothing happens", so the second option is the decline.
